svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Documentation set and its consumers
svg.desc: The documentation set as three lanes: the prose corpus, the osf crate whose test comments changed, and the lint tooling that reads both. The links between prose documents are the substance of the change.

g.text: OSF CRATE · RUST CLI AND ITS TESTS
LINT AND LINK TOOLING · OSF LINT, SKILL LINT, LINK CH…
